notes: This is the Liddell-Scott Greek-English lexicon (mixed Greek/English, small type). The non-merged random crops read accurately, including polytonic Greek, the italic English and the citations (1-14, 16-18, 20); the Latin/Greek mix and digits are genre, not errors. Every anomalous line (21-40) and random 15 and 19 are two half-lines joined across the column gutter (the crop shows the '|' rule). They carry D:column_crossing_line, so the pool-wide gutter rule removes them. The crossing share is only 0.6%, so the book does not need its own pattern.
